entities.summary: Hiroshi Nagai is a Japanese graphic designer and illustrator, known for his cover designs of city pop albums in the 1980s, which established the recognizable visual aesthetic associated with the loosely defined music genre. Hiroshi Nagai was a painters & sculptors from Tokushima (b. 1947-12-22, Tokushima). A moderately significant entity in the historical record. Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.
